# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 51 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Tablets Found by Solomon; Closing Colophon

---

**1** In the days of Solomon king of Israel, the tablets of Seth were found. Solomon read them and gave thanks to God.

**2** Solomon had all the words copied and written in the books of the kings of Israel.

**3** This is the end of the life of Adam and Eve, the first of all the living, whose hope is in the mercy of God.

**4** Glory be to God, who has mercy on all his creatures, now and forever.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
